title: Payment API Error Response
description: Structured error response format following Heroku API conventions.

id.description: Machine-readable error code. Lowercase with underscores.

message.description: Human-readable error description. Safe to display to end users.

url.description: Optional link to documentation for this error.

errors.description: Nested field-level errors. Present only when id is 'invalid_params'.

message.description: Human-readable description of this specific field issue.

url.description: Optional link to documentation for this sub-error.
